## 1 — Reason for revert (verbatim from user)

> «تعديل MOON-HIJRI-FIRST-VISIBLE-DATE-POLICY-1 لم يظهر كما نريد على الواجهة، وسبب ارتباكًا في عرض التاريخ الأساسي داخل صفحات القمر. لذلك نريد إلغاءه الآن والعودة إلى السياسة المعتمدة السابقة.»

**Specific browser-side issue observed by user on `/moon-in-riyadh/2026-05-23`:**
- H1 shown (post-hydration): "حالة القمر في الرياض يوم السبت 23 مايو 2026" (Gregorian — H1 flip didn't take effect)
- Subtitle: "الموافق السبت، 23 مايو 2026" (Gregorian with weekday — JS rewrote SSR output)

**Root cause (identified during debug, NOT fixed before revert):**
- SSR was correct (Hijri-primary H1 + Gregorian subtitle).
- After hydration, a second JS block at `js/app.js:20189-20196` ran AFTER the AR-Hijri-first H1 rewrite (`js/app.js:16941+`) and overwrote the H1 back to Gregorian via the `moon.h1_date_template` i18n key (which for AR resolves to the same string as `moon.h1_city_date`). The second block was not updated in `719789b`.
- A partial fix was attempted on disk during debug but was discarded before this revert per user direction — the cleanest path is to roll back to the proven stable state and re-design the policy from scratch in a future wave.
